title: Require the operations a generic algorithm uses
summary: Combine ordering and copying bounds in a where clause. Return a copied maximum and verify equality and negative-number cases.

constraints.clue: Keyword beginning the separate generic-bound clause

ordering.clue: Trait requiring a total ordering for the larger function’s type parameter

combine.clue: Syntax combining multiple required traits on one type parameter

copying.clue: Trait allowing implicit duplication of a generic value

condition.clue: Keyword selecting left when left is at least right

fallback.clue: Keyword selecting right when the comparison is false

borrowed.clue: Shared reference parameter type allowing a Clone implementation to duplicate a caller-owned value

clone.clue: Trait method creating an independent value of T from its shared borrow

equal.clue: Macro checking that the larger value is selected
